title: Quotient toward zero
description: Return a divided by b with the fractional part simply dropped, that is, rounded toward zero (not down): 7 divided by 2 is 3, -7 divided by 2 is -3, 7 divided by -2 is -3, and -7 divided by -2 is 3. b is never 0.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states truncation toward zero in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
